parsed.post: Huge jump! DEPTH 8 achieved 0.9875. It seems capacity is indeed the dominant lever and the 5-minute budget allows for significant convergence at this scale. Next, I will try reducing the learning rate slightly more to 0.03 to see if we can squeeze out more stability at this higher capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to test if a lower learning rate helps the larger model converge even further.
